findings.issue: Common noun הַפָּרֹכֶת is left untranslated as parójet; a common noun must be Spanish.
Preposition אֶת (with) is omitted; la parójet is a bare object instead of the means of covering.

notes: pondrás allí el arca del testimonio and sobre el arca match the put-there, testimony-ark, and upon-the-ark tokens.
